subject: RFP - annual partner conference, 45 delegates
body:
Hello,

We are looking for a venue for our annual partner conference: 45 delegates, a plenary plus three breakout rooms, dinner on both evenings, two midweek nights in October. Could you confirm availability and an indicative day delegate rate? We need to answer our board by Friday.

Best,
Julie Moreau
Head of Events, Northbridge Partners
